description: Response & Mitigation (app/services/response) inputs. The runner first asks the real PolicyDecisionEngine to allow each response, then feeds that decision into the real ResponseExecutor with the shipped MockResponseProvider ('mock'). Nothing is written to a real firewall, EDR, identity system, host, process or file. No execution_status, response_id, provider or message is recorded here.

scenarios.purpose: A policy-allowed block_ip executes through the mock provider and yields execution_status=executed.
A policy-DENIED isolate_endpoint is refused by the response layer before any provider is contacted.
A REQUIRES_APPROVAL decision is not executable without a real approval grant, so the response is rejected/skiped with an approval error code.
Submitting the same (policy_decision_id, action_type, target) twice must be suppressed by the deterministic idempotency key: the same response_id is returned and only one execution is recorded.
An unsupported target shape for the action type is rejected by app.services.response.validator.validate_target and no provider is contacted.
